component.title: CollectionList
component.purpose: Browse records with distinct open-detail, keyboard-cursor, and bulk-selection states.

states.description: Triage is open while the initial keyboard cursor belongs to Support.
Opening a record updates its current marker.
Arrow navigation and Home/End move actual focus through measured virtual rows.

claims.statement: The current record remains visibly marked independently of cursor navigation; unfocused collections do not paint a keyboard cursor.
The keyboard cursor and DOM focus identify the same record, including destinations initially outside the virtual viewport. Embedded editor keys retain their native behavior.
